_comment: Lore-only remains at the farmland's burnt cart (content-zone-1-farmland.md §2.4, the bandit breadcrumb): an object that talks, the forest-sign.json shape (townsfolk, collisionLayer 97 so no aura targets it, role creature + speed 0, xpFactor 0, one node with no options). EntityType Remains, the talkable dead-body sprite; RemainsProp is the same art as silent dressing. No quest names it. All values [PLACEHOLDER]; text plain.
name: DeadCarter

lines.text: A dead carter lies face down beside his burnt cart.
His purse is gone and his crates are smashed. There are arrows in the wood of the cart.
